rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: CHAP. LIV. Fish Stolen.
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: A distinct section called Fish Stolen begins, printed with numeral LIV.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: It follows LXIII in source order; logical position LXIV, do not conflate with earlier Buying and Selling chapter.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: printed LIV, sequential LXIV
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The original numeral and sequential position differ.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Preserve both identifiers rather than silently correcting the source.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: square horoscope Fish Stolen
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: An original square twelve-house horoscope accompanies this question.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: This is not the previous circular money theft figure.

rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The diagram centre prints 10 February 1638, 8:45 AM.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Calendar and geographic time basis not independently authenticated.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: hor astr Jupiter
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The chart carries an hour-ruler annotation involving Jupiter.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Keep original glyph and uncertainty; no ephemeris parity.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: living in Country 1637; Fish for Lent
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly says he bought London fish while living in the country in 1637.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Historical chronology distinguished from figure year 1638.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Walton boat delivery Saturday 10 February
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The fish was brought by boat to Walton on 10 February.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Only original report, no independent consignment documents.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Boatman said warehouse had been robbed
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The author heard from a boatman that the warehouse had been robbed.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The news predates figure casting.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: my Fish stolen
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He states that his fish had been stolen.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Thief identification remains disputed.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: exact time first heard report
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The author says he cast the horary at the precise moment he received news of loss.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No external prediction timestamp or independent witness.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: what became Goods; recover part or all
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He asks what happened to the missing fish and whether part or all could be recovered.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Different endpoints must not be pooled.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: first-person source-worked demonstration
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: This is a historical worked case with observations and eventual search.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Generalizations appear later before next numbered chapter.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: no peregrine Planet in angle but Jupiter
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly observes Jupiter as the only relevant peregrine planet in an angle.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Original original glyph and essential-dignity conditions matter.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Jupiter on cusp seventh
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Jupiter is said to be located at the seventh-house cusp.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Angle and cusp are distinct original source features.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Jupiter in Scorpio moist Signe
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Jupiter is described as occupying Scorpio, a moist sign.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Historic elemental classification; no modern causal inference.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Mercury significator Goods in Pisces
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Mercury as significator of goods is described as occupying Pisces.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Do not confuse goods-ruler with selected suspect significator Jupiter.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Part Fortune in Cancer and Moon in Taurus
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Part Fortune in Cancer and Moon in an earthy sign are invoked.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Authorial chart assertion only; independent ephemeris parity absent.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: man whose calling was upon Water
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly infers that the person holding the goods worked on or around water.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: A historical suspicion, not verified criminal evidence.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: goods in moist place or low room
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He infers a damp location or room near ground level.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Alternatives in a paragraph, not separately verified beforehand.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Mercury Lord second applied unto by sextile of Moon
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Moon's sextile application to Mercury, second-house lord, is said to support hearing about goods.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Source does not claim immediate full recovery.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Moon Lady of Part Fortune
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The Moon is tied to the Part of Fortune in the judgment.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not a universally verified recovery indicator.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Mercury in fall and detriment
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The weak essential condition of Mercury reduces hopes of retrieving fish.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Explicit qualification; do not count full recovery.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Mercury in own Terms
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Mercury being in its own terms is presented as some mitigation.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Qualifying benefit does not erase fall/detriment.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: trine to Part of Fortune
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: A trine with Part Fortune is added as recovery testimony.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Aspect belongs to source-native chart doctrine.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: hope of some of my Goods
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly says he expected information and some of the fish back, though not all.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: A partial forecast, not unqualified full restitution.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: no Walton Waterman matched Jupiter Scorpio
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says local boatmen failed to match the suspect description he inferred.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Failed initial search must not be omitted.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: examined Fishermen of that complexion
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He then sought fishermen fitting the profile.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Search selection occurred after astrological interpretation; introduces investigator influence.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Mars Lord seventh
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Mars is treated as ruler of the seventh house for another part of the judgment.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Different from Jupiter on seventh cusp, with distinct interpretation.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Mars departing Scorpio, entering another Signe
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Mars leaving Scorpio is interpreted as change of place.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The original speaks of Mars own sign; retain condition.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: land sold or leaving proper house
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly uses this transition to suspect the person recently sold land or was moving residence.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not shown independently before the subsequent inquiry.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: fisherman suspected departing habitation
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says he found a fisherman fitting the moving-residence possibility.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Investigative filtering influenced by prediction.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: lived near Thames side; conversant in waters
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The suspect reportedly lived beside the Thames and worked as a fisherman.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Source allegation of involvement, not independently proven guilt.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: significators in watry Signs live near water
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly generalizes from watery signs to occupations or places near water.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: A historical rule untested out of sample.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: good stature, thick and full bodied
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The suspected fisherman is described as substantial and full-bodied.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No independent anthropometric record.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: fair complexion, red or yellowish hair
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly gives complexion and hair-color descriptions.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Source-native characterization, not verified identity or diagnostic evidence.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: procured a Warrant from Justice of Peace
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly reports obtaining a legal warrant before the search.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Independent judicial documentation not supplied.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Sunday eighteenth February following
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says the search occurred on Sunday 18 February, after the dated chart.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Chronology of investigation matters for interpreting reported outcomes.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Constable and Barge-man searched one house
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The author says he and companions searched only the chosen fisherman's house.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: This is not a blind search of all comparable homes.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: part Fish in water, part eaten, part not consumed
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says some fish was found in water, some already eaten, and some still uneaten.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Partial recovery rather than complete recovery.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: all confessed
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He asserts the people involved confessed in the search.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: No external deposition or independent evidentiary record supplied.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: fish in a bag
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly says the fish had been contained in a bag.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Do not confuse fish recovery with return of the container.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: bag taken together with Fish
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says the bag also went missing in the incident.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Separate loss/outcome: recovery not established at same level as fish.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Barge-man whose sack said he recognized bag
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: A boatman is said to have noticed the sack at the searched home.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: His awareness and earlier observation are disputed in original narrative.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: woman never had a sack but husband's same night
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The woman is reported as saying she had only a sack brought home by her husband that night.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Competing ownership/identification claims not independently adjudicated.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: woman washed sack clean
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly claims the bag had been washed, contributing to prior failure to recognize it.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Author interpretation, not independent proof of knowledge or concealment.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: boatman looked on sack many times, not knowing it
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He asserts the boatman had seen the bag many times but did not recognize it because it was washed.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Do not conflate subjective recognition with independent chain of custody.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: seven Portugall Onions lost
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly also says seven Portuguese onions had disappeared.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: An additional item separate from fish and bag.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: made pottage with Onions not knowing what they were
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The woman reportedly admitted cooking the onions as pottage without recognizing them.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: The asserted lack of knowledge must be preserved, not rewritten as intentional theft.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: remainder of Fish freely remitted
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: The author says he forgave or relinquished the unrecovered remainder.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Retain as loss/nonrecovery rather than calling full restitution.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Priest of Walton asserted satisfaction
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He attributes to the local priest a claim that he had received satisfaction.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Third-party statement from the same author's narration, not independently verified.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: he never hurt himself with a lye
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly insinuates the priest was lying.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: A historical accusation, not verified moral or criminal fact.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: peregrine Planet in angle describes Thiefe
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Lilly generalizes that an angular peregrine planet describes the alleged thief.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Not independently tested; individual guilt cannot be inferred.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Sun or Moon in ascendant in essential Dignities
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says Sun or Moon in the first house with essential dignity gives hope of identifying the person.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Both planetary placement and dignity are specified conditions.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: assured hopes of discovering who it was
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He characterizes these as assurances of discovery.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Author confidence wording, not measured probability.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: Moon apply to Lord second argues recovery
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Applying Moon aspect to second-house lord is said to support recovering goods.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Original source says application, not merely any aspect.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: full recovery if both essentially dignified
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: Complete recovery is associated with essential dignity of both Moon and second lord.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Must keep BOTH, and distinguish essential from accidental.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: part if accidentally fortified
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: A partial return is predicted if they are accidentally fortified.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: Source syntax needs preservation; no numeric threshold.

rules.short_anchor_not_full_quote: discovery no recovery if apply both peregrine
rules.historical_source_paraphrase: He says application between two peregrines can produce discovery without goods returned.
rules.source_conditions_uncertainty: This is a negative case, essential to avoid cherry-picking the author's examples.

rules.historical_source_paraphrase: A separate military horary chapter about Waller and Hopton begins below the divider on original PDF433.
